notes: Rule 425 filing of an 8-K announcing the SLRC/SUNS BDC merger (two-step: merger sub into SUNS, then SUNS into SLRC). Exchange ratio is set at closing as SUNS per-share NAV over SLRC per-share NAV (NAV for NAV), so no fixed ratio is stated; fractional shares paid in cash. Only SLRC is printed as a trading symbol; SUNS appears only as a defined abbreviation, so tickers lists SLRC alone. The 'other' condition is the NAV determination condition (item 7); the base fee reduction (item 8) is also a condition. Outside date December 1, 2022 is the date after which either party may terminate. Termination fees (about $25,604,700 and $7,572,270) are stated but the merger kind has no field for them. No meeting or record date stated.
